Port rust/lichen-hal/src/storage.rs provision_redundant/open_redundant/update_redundant to C in lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_storage_redundant.c, storage-agnostic via an ops vtable in the project style (cf. struct lichen_replay_store_ops in replay_persist.h): read(user,key,out,cap,*len) -\u003e 0 found / 1 missing / -errno; write(user,key,value,len). Keys 'rpl.tx.a'/'rpl.tx.b' and magic 'DTX2' stay with the CALLER (child b7z9.11.2), not the primitive. new_value: Duplicate of the already-landed two-slot primitive: lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/redundant_slot.c/.h + CMake wiring committed as fda3af992f on beads-worker-7 (child of b7z9.11.1, which this bead's own discovered-from references — b7z9.11.1 is CLOSED). Committed host tests: lichen/tests/redundant_slot/ (a2ct, commit 367cc730b2) covering empty->Missing, provision/-EEXIST, alternation, Stale (corrupt + slot-drop), Corrupt (both-slots), EOVERFLOW wrap, rollback on write failure, and the CRC32 bit-exactness pin vs the Rust crc32 (trailer 0xBD88FA92 for the DTX2/gen1/'123456789' record). API-style differences vs this bead's sketch (ops vtable read returning 0/1/-errno vs my read returning len/0/-errno; placement redundant_slot.c vs hal_storage_redundant.c) are immaterial — the committed primitive satisfies the same contract (provision Exists, newest-valid open with Missing/Corrupt taxonomy, opposite-slot update at generation+1, Stale mismatch, u64 wrap terminal). b7z9.11.2 (DAO TX state machine) consumes the committed redundant_slot.h. Do not implement a second primitive.
